Druid/Balance.note: Published marginal coefficients normalized to the addon reference units. Talent operations apply changes relative to the explicit representative ranks. Encounter-specific armor penetration and spell piercing require a target resistance or armor model.

Druid/Feral dps.note: Published marginal coefficients normalized to the addon reference units. Talent operations apply changes relative to the explicit representative ranks. Encounter-specific armor penetration and spell piercing require a target resistance or armor model.

Druid/Feral tank.alternative_review: Current published short-fight or threat coefficients, with units normalized to the default anchor. Capped tank Hit derivatives do not replace uncapped Hit weights; unmeasured bear weapon DPS retains the qualified default estimate.
Druid/Feral tank.alternative_units: SixtySim Per point Expertise, Block and Parry are rating coefficients, converted to percentage reduction or chance with the client gametable. Explicit Per 1 % entries remain percentage coefficients.
Druid/Feral tank.note: Published marginal coefficients normalized to the addon reference units. Talent operations apply changes relative to the explicit representative ranks. Encounter-specific armor penetration and spell piercing require a target resistance or armor model. Retain the reviewed survivability budget and calibrate physical and spell threat against the published weapon-DPS ratios. Defense and avoidance are survival inputs. Personal swaps also evaluate the recorded SixtySim one-minute threat coefficients. Armor and avoidance omitted by that threat benchmark score zero only in the alternative. A survival-versus-threat reversal uses conditional advice.

Druid/Restoration.alternative_review: Current published short-fight or threat coefficients, with units normalized to the default anchor. Capped tank Hit derivatives do not replace uncapped Hit weights; unmeasured bear weapon DPS retains the qualified default estimate. Restoration uses its published 11/0/40 healing reference, without deep-Feral Natural Instinct. The -0.03 MP5 finite-step result is treated as zero: the source describes it as no mana value in this non-mana-limited fight; retain the raw measurement in comparison evidence.
Druid/Restoration.note: Published marginal coefficients normalized to the addon reference units. Talent operations apply changes relative to the explicit representative ranks. Encounter-specific armor penetration and spell piercing require a target resistance or armor model. Use the published sustainable healing formula; compare the short-fight simulator separately for mana sensitivity. The recorded short-fight reference is also evaluated; a reversal qualifies the personal swap.

reference_talent_review.build: Horde 11/0/40, two points Heart of the Wild, three Living Spirit and five Gift of Nature; no Feral Natural Instinct.
reference_talent_review.reason: Natural Instinct is deep Feral, absent from the published healing build. Do not subtract its Intellect-to-healing conversion from a Restoration reference coefficient.

Hunter/Survival.note: Weaving reference with one third melee participation and two thirds ranged. GearMatic does not publish the main-hand coefficient and the SixtySim table explicitly does not measure it. Retain the prior reviewed 3-point melee-DPS coefficient and qualify melee-weapon tradeoffs. Add the separately measured SixtySim melee AP, Strength and Expertise contributions; generic item AP and Careful Aim benefit both attack powers. The one-minute SixtySim Haste trend is negative, so Haste-sensitive swaps also use that alternative. This is a qualified reference estimate, not an exact simulation.

gearmatic.hit_normalization: The piecewise hit curve has unit initial slope under the recorded passive reference talents. Fury off-hand hit is already past the specials cap, so its remaining white-attack contribution is normalized before applying the published marginal coefficient.
gearmatic.limitations: The published scale artifact records simulator provenance and coefficients but does not embed a complete per-profile loadout and encounter configuration. The addon records representative talents and a first-tier boss reference rather than claiming to reproduce that simulation. SixtySim provides the separate documented loadout and one-minute comparison.
gearmatic.units: Damage and healing scales use anchor 6. Mixed tank formula tables retain their published coefficients and are calibrated by weapon-DPS threat ratios. Rating coefficients are per point. Convert hit, crit, haste and expertise to percentage units with the Forever gametable.

sixtysim.limitations: Older build, common simulator ancestry, reference loadouts and rotations. Tank tables emphasize threat. Short healing fights underprice long-fight mana.
sixtysim.sim_commit_scope: Current methodology page; individual comparison pages retain the engines and dates in comparison_sources.
